dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply concave curvature along the trailing edge, characterized by a smooth inward spline from the posterior base to the sub-apex region.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology with a wide pixel radius at the highest point, lacking acute termination.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep linear trajectory of the anterior margin, maintaining a consistent positive slope from the lower right base to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.1:1 ratio of maximum horizontal base width to maximum vertical pixel height.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Several small, white punctate depigmentation marks scattered across the mid-lateral surface; minor irregular edge roughness on the lower third of the trailing margin.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced grainy or mottled texture visible across the dark pigment of the fin surface.
